title: Record that the named schedule does not cite event 5759
body:
## Summary
- The tail readme points at pull request 1940 and says the tail word does not integrate with that schedule. The merged package is `research/p104-target-order-delivery`.
- None of its eight files contain event 5759 or the tail seed. Its complete-cost formula leaves side corrections and hosting unresolved.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. This reading does not build an owner map.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/p104-tail-flag0-schedule/verify.py`
